place.source_title: National Home for Disabled Volunteer Soldiers, Northwestern Branch, Quarters

brief: Two-storey clapboard staff quarters with a hipped roof and small hipped dormer, a tall corbelled brick chimney, regular 1/1 windows and an enclosed screened porch on one side of the front reached by wood steps; set on a sloping lawn with a front walk.

facade.notes: a staff residence at the National Soldiers' Home (Milwaukee, 1900): a large hipped Colonial Revival frame house with an eyebrow dormer and a screened side porch, on the grounds' curving walks; a hospital tower behind

why.note: an institution's staff house on a common lawn
